name: Create Algorithm Flowchart Lesson
description:
A 6th-grade Computer Science teacher needs a flipchart to introduce algorithms and flowcharts. Create a 2-page ActivInspire flipchart:

Page 1 — 'Flowchart Symbols': Create a key with the title 'Flowchart Symbols'. Draw and label three distinct shapes:
- An Oval labeled 'Start / End'
- A Rectangle labeled 'Process'
- A Diamond (or Rhombus) labeled 'Decision'

Page 2 — 'Morning Routine Algorithm': Create a flowchart with the title 'Morning Routine Algorithm'. It must include:
- A Start node (Oval)
- A process 'Alarm Rings' (Rectangle)
- A decision 'Is it a weekday?' (Diamond)
- Two branches from the decision: 'Yes' leading to 'Get Up' and 'No' leading to 'Sleep In'
- Use lines or connectors to link these shapes in a logical flow.

Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/algorithm_flowchart.flipchart'.
